// Leak (d), first half: RANGE OVER THE VAULT'S held MAP.
//
// This is the leak an adversarial reviewer found after the vault closed the first three, and it
// was measured reading an SSTI observation and a SQL observation out of a single SSTI handle with
// the owner check never consulted. One handle plus one range statement is every class's response.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakRangeVault(p triage.Perturbed) []triage.Observation {
	var out []triage.Observation
	for _, e := range p.vault.held {
		out = append(out, e.obs)
	}
	return out
}
